title: Toddler Girl Sitting on Front Porch Steps, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-20th-century snapshot capturing a smiling young girl seated on the concrete front steps of a brick suburban residence. She is dressed in a light-colored dress with a pleated skirt and puffed sleeves, accompanied by white ankle socks and dark shoes. Behind her, a storm door features the house number '3081' and a patterned doormat rests on the porch beside a decorative wrought iron railing.
